Quantum 1.16.0 was certified on 2026-08-25. It pins **nucleus v1.12.0**, **quark v1.6.0** and **orbit v1.6.7**, with 5 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.15.0: nucleus goes from v1.11.0 to v1.12.0 (minor), orbit goes from v1.6.6 to v1.6.7 (patch) and quark stays at v1.6.0. 3 sibling modules change version.
